evidence.title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use

summary: The new MidTool framework generates synthetic data during a model's training phase, enabling AI agents to learn more effective tool‑use behaviors. By integrating this mid‑training data synthesis, the approach improves performance on tasks requiring complex interactions with external tools.
title: Researchers unveil MidTool, a mid‑training data synthesis technique to boost agentic tool use
